jcr:title: Introduction to Apache Sling
author: cms-admin
body:
Apache Sling is a web framework that uses a Java Content Repository, such as Apache Jackrabbit, to store and manage content. It implements a REST-based web application that provides easy development of content-oriented applications.

Sling is built on top of OSGi, providing a modular architecture that allows for dynamic deployment and management of components. The framework maps HTTP requests to content resources, making it ideal for content management systems.
summary: An overview of Apache Sling, the web framework that powers content-oriented applications.
tags: Apache Sling, Web Framework, Content Management, OSGi, JCR
